post.description: Log in with email **or** username. Returns tokens and the signed-in user. If two-factor authentication is on, returns `code: MFA_REQUIRED` with an `mfa_challenge` instead: call `POST /auth/mfa/verify`. If `user.must_change_password` or `user.mfa_setup_required` is true, finish that step before using other endpoints.
